label: one-task, four-cell whole-scaffold qualification

proxy.budget_policy: Reserve a conservative full-request upper bound before forwarding; retain reservations after uncertain or failed requests. No paid replacements or additional repetitions.

controls: Fresh official gold must resolve; harmless nonempty add-file patch must apply and remain unresolved. Both must finish without evaluator errors before the proxy can start.
network: Inference containers use one internal Docker network with host-proxy access only; package setup finishes before inference. No hidden tests or reference patch remain inside containers.
dependency_freeze: Pinned AskMe and FeatureBench uv.lock; exact pi package and generated transitive npm lock, Node checksum and derived image ID retained before inference. All cells share that derived image.
source_freeze: Exact workflow commit, manifest SHA256 and one GitHub run ID are recorded in eval/claims/pi-sep14-v1 before the credentialed step. A second run ID or run attempt is rejected.
differences: Pi is an external whole-scaffold reference: prompts, planner, tools, requested per-call output allowance and completion semantics differ. This is not a causal component ablation.
Total external call/generated-token/wall/spend ceilings and within-model routes are equal; AskMe retains its native smaller planner/step token requests and internal step limits.
Gemma uses currently available CoreWeave fp4; Qwen uses SiliconFlow fp8. These differ from historical v6 routes/precision; historical results are not contemporary controls.
The known Seaborn task was already used in development and is excluded from future confirmation panels. It is episode-hidden, not contamination-free.
decision_rule: Retain and report all four cells including budget exhaustion, timeouts, malformed sessions and evaluator failures. Do not retry after any model call. Stop after this instrumentation check; expansion requires a new protocol. No benchmark score, reliability, readiness, model-family/size, ceiling or component-effect claim.
